title: HyperBrowseComp: A Multilingual and Multimodal Stress Test for Web-Browsing Agents
title_zh: HyperBrowseComp: 一个包含13种语言的手写并经人工验证的多语言和多模态浏览基准

paragraphs.en: We introduce HyperBrowseComp , a multilingual and multimodal browsing benchmark comprising 423 manually authored and human-validated questions across 13 languages, written by native or highly proficient speakers. Questions are designed to be extremely challenging. Each question targets a concise, publicly verifiable answer whose discovery requires locating obscure evidence, following multi-step clue chains, or inspecting heterogeneous sources such as videos, scanned documents, images, or maps. Easier questions are filtered out by evaluating them with models without internet access to reduce the likelihood that they can be answered with parametric knowledge alone. We evaluate several models using provider-native search and a shared external retrieval harness under a common agent protocol. To contextualize model performance and effort, we also conduct a human evaluation on a sample of the questions. HyperBrowseComp provides a challenging testbed for persistent information seeking across languages and evidence modalities, with difficulty arising from discovering and connecting evidence on the open web.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 HyperBrowseComp，这是一个多语言、多模态的浏览基准测试，包含由母语者或语言能力高度熟练者编写、并经人类验证的 423 个问题，覆盖 13 种语言。 这些问题被设计得极具挑战性。 每个问题都指向一个简洁且可公开验证的答案，而找到该答案需要定位冷门证据、遵循多步骤的线索链，或检查视频、扫描文档、图像或地图等异构来源。 我们通过使用无法访问互联网模型对这些问题进行评估，筛选出较简单的问题，从而降低仅凭参数化知识就能回答它们的可能性。 我们使用提供商原生的搜索功能以及一个共享的外部检索工具，在统一的智能体协议下对多个模型进行了评估。 为了说明模型的性能和努力程度，我们还对部分问题进行了人类评估。 HyperBrowseComp 为跨语言和证据模态的持续信息搜寻提供了一个富有挑战性的测试平台，其难度源于在开放网络中查找并关联证据。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only as conversational systems, but also as tool-using agents that search the web, inspect external sources, and synthesize evidence-grounded answers. This shift has motivated evaluations of web browsing, tool use, and long-horizon information seeking, including GAIA, WebArena, and BrowseComp ( Mialon et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) . At the same time, rapidly improving model performance has reduced the discriminative power of many static question-answering benchmarks, motivating challenging evaluations such as GPQA and Humanity’s Last Exam ( Rein et al., 2024 ; Phan et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地用于不仅是对话系统，也是能够使用工具的智能体，这些智能体可以搜索网络、检查外部来源，并合成基于证据的答案。 这一转变推动了网络浏览、工具使用和长期信息检索能力的评估，包括 GAIA、WebArena 和 BrowseComp（Mialon 等人，2024；Zhou 等人，2024；Wei 等人，2025）。 与此同时，模型性能的快速提升削弱了许多静态问答基准的区分能力，因此催生了更具挑战性的评估，如 GPQA 和 Humanity’s Last Exam（Rein 等人，2024；Phan 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: However, existing browsing evaluations generally isolate only a subset of the challenges encountered during real-world searches. The original BrowseComp emphasizes persistent open-web browsing, but is English-centric and predominantly textual ( Wei et al., 2025 ) . Beyond that, BrowseComp questions are typically trivia-like, and such are also prone to oversaturation, as LLM captures more knowledge in the parametric knowledge. Language-specific extensions such as BrowseComp-ZH and K-BrowseComp evaluate Chinese and Korean web environments, respectively ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) . Cross-lingual BrowseComp-Plus (XBCP) studies multilingual retrieval through a controlled translation-based construction: its questions and answers remain in English, while supporting documents are translated into multiple languages ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . In parallel, MMSearch, MM-BrowseComp, BrowseComp- V 3 V^{3} , and MERRIN extend web-search evaluation to visual, video, and audio evidence ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . These efforts establish important individual axes of evaluation. Beyond combining natively authored multilingual questions with multilingual, multimodal open-web evidence, HyperBrowseComp emphasizes interpretive search: although each question has a unique answer, relevant entities, relationships, sources, and evidence modalities may be implicit. An agent must first determine what and where to search, aggregate and compare candidate answers, or perform multi-hop retrieval to locate and verify the final result.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的浏览评估通常仅关注真实世界搜索中所遇到挑战的一个子集。 最初的 BrowseComp 强调持续性的开放网络浏览，但主要以英语为中心且以文本为主（Wei et al., 2025）。 此外，BrowseComp 的问题通常是类似常识问答的形式，这类问题也容易过度饱和，因为大语言模型在参数化知识中已掌握了更多信息。 针对特定语言的扩展版本，如 BrowseComp-ZH 和 K-BrowseComp，分别评估了中文和韩文的网络环境（Zhou et al., 2025；Lee et al., 2026）。 跨语言 BrowseComp-Plus（XBCP）通过受控的基于翻译的构建方式研究多语言检索：其问题和答案仍保留为英文，而支持性文档则被翻译成多种语言（Lu et al., 2026）。 与此同时，MMSearch、MM-BrowseComp、BrowseComp-V 3 V^{3} 和 MERRIN 将网络搜索评估扩展到了视觉、视频和音频证据领域（Jiang et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026）。 这些工作确立了评估的重要独立维度。 除了结合原生撰写的多语言问题与多语言、多模态的开放网络证据外，HyperBrowseComp 还强调解释性搜索：尽管每个问题都有唯一答案，但相关的实体、关系、来源和证据类型可能并不明确。 智能体必须首先确定搜索的内容和位置，然后聚合并比较候选答案，或执行多跳检索以定位并验证最终结果。

It asks for information about a specific bank located near a place referenced during a video game playthrough. A model must identify the relevant video, consult map data, and cross-reference geographical details; all while processing multilingual content. paragraphs.en: Consequently, we introduce HyperBrowseComp , a challenging benchmark designed to stress-test an agent’s ability to locate obscure but publicly verifiable information on the open web. Its questions are manually authored by speakers of the corresponding languages and are grounded in information available in those languages and their associated web environments. Many questions additionally require agents to reason over heterogeneous sources and extract decisive evidence from non-textual content. Beyond that, we make an active decision to craft the question to be extremely difficult to stress-test the system with a hope for more long-lasting benchmark lifespan.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出了 HyperBrowseComp——一个具有挑战性的基准测试，旨在对智能体在开放网络中定位晦涩但可公开验证信息的能力进行压力测试。 其问题由对应语言的使用者手动编写，并基于这些语言及其相关网络环境中可获得的信息。 许多问题还要求智能体对异构来源进行推理，并从非文本内容中提取决定性证据。 除此之外，我们主动决定将问题设计得极具难度，以对该系统施加压力测试，期望基准测试能拥有更持久的生命力。

paragraphs.en: We introduce HyperBrowseComp , a multimodal search benchmark which contains 423 questions manually authored in 13 languages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 HyperBrowseComp，这是一个多模态搜索基准测试，包含 13 种语言中人工编写的 423 个问题。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated 5 web-search enabled frontier LLMs and benchmarked three search integration methods (built-in, Exa, and OWL) to analyze accuracy, cost, and failure cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 5 款支持网页搜索的前沿大型语言模型（LLM），并对三种搜索集成方法（内置、Exa 和 OWL）进行了基准测试，以分析其准确性、成本及失败情况。

paragraphs.en: Several recent benchmarks aim to preserve discriminative power as general-purpose language models improve. GPQA consists of graduate-level questions in biology, chemistry, and physics that are difficult even for skilled non-experts with unrestricted web access ( Rein et al., 2024 ) . Humanity’s Last Exam extends this objective to broad, expert-authored, multimodal academic questions ( Phan et al., 2025 ) . On multilinguality side, Last Translation Benchmark focuses on challenging translation benchmark ( Zouhar et al., 2026 ) . These benchmarks primarily evaluate domain knowledge and closed-ended reasoning. Although web access may be allowed or considered during evaluation, sustained open-web information seeking is not their central construct.
paragraphs.zh: 近期多项基准测试旨在随着通用语言模型的性能提升，保留其区分能力。 GPQA 包含生物学、化学和物理学领域的研究生水平问题，这些问题即使对于拥有无限制网络访问权限的熟练非专家而言也具有挑战性（Rein 等，2024）。 Humanity’s Last Exam 将这一目标扩展至由专家编写、涵盖多种模态的广泛学术问题（Phan 等，2025）。 在多语言性方面，Last Translation Benchmark 专注于具有挑战性的翻译基准测试（Zouhar 等，2026）。 这些基准测试主要评估领域知识和封闭式推理能力。 尽管在评估过程中可能允许或考虑使用网络访问，但持续地从开放网络中获取信息并非这些测试的核心设计。

paragraphs.en: GAIA evaluates general-purpose assistants on questions requiring reasoning, browsing, multimodal understanding, and tool use ( Mialon et al., 2024 ) . WebArena instead evaluates agents executing realistic tasks in reproducible, self-hosted web environments ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) . BrowseComp focuses more narrowly on persistent open-web search, using difficult questions with short and verifiable answers ( Wei et al., 2025 ) . BrowseComp-Plus grounds similar questions in a fixed corpus with human-verified supporting documents and hard negatives, enabling more controlled comparisons between retrievers and agents ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . SealQA studies search-augmented reasoning when retrieved information is noisy, conflicting, or misleading ( Pham et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: GAIA 通过需要推理、浏览、多模态理解和工具使用的问题来评估通用型助手（Mialon 等，2024）。 WebArena 则评估智能体在可重复、自托管的网页环境中执行真实任务的能力（Zhou 等，2024）。 BrowseComp 更专注于持续性的开放网络搜索，使用答案简短且可验证的难题进行测试（Wei 等，2025）。 BrowseComp-Plus 将类似问题置于固定语料库中，并配备经人类验证的支持性文档和具有挑战性的负样本，从而能够在信息检索器和智能体之间进行更受控的比较（Chen 等，2025）。 SealQA 研究了在检索到的信息存在噪声、冲突或误导性时，搜索增强型推理的表现（Pham 等，2025）。

sents.en: BrowseComp focuses more narrowly on persistent open-web search, using difficult questions with short and verifiable answers ( Wei et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: BrowseComp 更专注于持续性的开放网络搜索，使用答案简短且可验证的难题进行测试（Wei 等，2025）。

sents.en: BrowseComp-Plus grounds similar questions in a fixed corpus with human-verified supporting documents and hard negatives, enabling more controlled comparisons between retrievers and agents ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: BrowseComp-Plus 将类似问题置于固定语料库中，并配备经人类验证的支持性文档和具有挑战性的负样本，从而能够在信息检索器和智能体之间进行更受控的比较（Chen 等，2025）。

sents.en: SealQA studies search-augmented reasoning when retrieved information is noisy, conflicting, or misleading ( Pham et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: SealQA 研究了在检索到的信息存在噪声、冲突或误导性时，搜索增强型推理的表现（Pham 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: HyperBrowseComp follows BrowseComp’s emphasis on hard-to-find but easily verifiable answers. Importantly, it differs from BrowseComp by having simultaneously multimodal and multilingual questions requiring aggregation of more varied sources, and differs from BrowseComp-Plus by not having a static fixed corpus and instead operates on the open dynamic internet, closer to what browsing agents would realistically encounter. Table 1 compares HyperBrowseComp with other extensions of the original BrowseComp benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: HyperBrowseComp 延续了 BrowseComp 对难以查找但易于验证的答案的强调。 重要的是，它与 BrowseComp 的不同之处在于，它同时处理多模态和多语言问题，需要整合更多样化的来源；而与 BrowseComp-Plus 的不同则在于，它没有静态固定的语料库，而是运行在开放动态的互联网上，更贴近智能体在实际浏览中可能遇到的情况。 表 1 将 HyperBrowseComp 与其他对原始 BrowseComp 基准的扩展进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: BrowseComp-ZH and K-BrowseComp adapt difficult browsing evaluation to Chinese and Korean contexts ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) , respectively. These benchmarks demonstrate that language-specific information ecosystems introduce retrieval and reasoning challenges not adequately represented by English-only evaluation. XBCP studies a complementary multilingual setting using a controlled translation-based construction, in which the questions and answers remain in English while supporting documents are translated into multiple languages ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, questions in HyperBrowseComp are authored directly and independently in their respective languages, rather than translated from a shared set of English questions. This allows the benchmark to capture language-specific phrasing, terminology, cultural references, and information available within different web environments.
paragraphs.zh: BrowseComp-ZH 和 K-BrowseComp 分别将复杂的浏览评估任务适配到了中文和韩语语境中（Zhou 等人，2025；Lee 等人，2026）。 这些基准测试表明，特定语言的信息生态系统带来了检索与推理方面的挑战，而这些挑战仅通过英语评估无法充分体现。 XBCP 研究了一种互补的多语言设置，采用受控的基于翻译的构建方式：问题和答案保留为英语，而支持性文档则被翻译成多种语言（Lu 等人，2026）。 相比之下，HyperBrowseComp 中的问题则是直接在各自的语言中独立编写，而非从一组共享的英语问题翻译而来。 这使得该基准测试能够捕捉到不同语言特有的表达方式、术语、文化参照以及不同网络环境中的可用信息。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal search benchmarks evaluate another complementary dimension. MMSearch studies multimodal querying, reranking, and answer generation over text-image web content ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . MM-BrowseComp introduces difficult browsing questions whose prompts or supporting evidence may include images and videos ( Li et al., 2025 ) . BrowseComp- V 3 V^{3} emphasizes multi-hop reasoning across textual and visual web evidence and provides process-level subgoals ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . MERRIN further evaluates retrieval and reasoning over noisy evidence that includes video and audio ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . HyperBrowseComp builds on this literature by combining natively authored multilingual questions with a broad range of web evidence, including webpages, images, video, audio, scanned books and reports, maps, tables, figures, and other visually rendered sources.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态搜索基准测试评估了另一个互补的维度。 MMSearch 研究了在文本与图像网络内容上的多模态查询、重排序和答案生成（Jiang 等，2025）。 MM-BrowseComp 引入了具有挑战性的浏览问题，其提示或支持证据可能包含图像和视频（Li 等，2025）。 BrowseComp- V 3 V^{3} 强调在文本与视觉网络证据之间进行多跳推理，并提供流程级别的子目标（Zhang 等，2026）。 MERRIN 进一步评估了包含视频和音频的噪声证据中的检索与推理能力（Wang 等，2026）。 HyperBrowseComp 在此基础上，将原生撰写的多语言问题与广泛的网络证据相结合，包括网页、图像、视频、音频、扫描书籍和报告、地图、表格、图表以及其他视觉呈现的来源。

paragraphs.en: Following BrowseComp, each question is designed to have a single, easily distinguishable answer, such as one specific entity, name, date, or numerical value. Keeping answers concise and unambiguous simplifies evaluation and reduces disagreement during judging, while allowing the difficulty of the benchmark to come from finding the answer rather than interpreting it. Hence, questions should be non-ambiguous and factual, rather than essay-like or opinionated.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 BrowseComp 的设计原则，每个问题都旨在只有一个易于区分的正确答案，例如某个特定的实体、名称、日期或数值。 保持答案简洁且无歧义，可以简化评估过程，减少评分时的争议，同时让基准测试的难度体现在寻找答案上，而非对答案的解释上。 因此，问题应当是非歧义的且基于事实的，而不是像论述题或表达个人观点的问题。

paragraphs.en: The questions were authored by native or highly proficient speakers, with the guiding principle that fluency of the language would be required to find and/or navigate the sources from which the answers draw upon. No seed English dataset was used. This design preserved language-specific terminology, cultural context, and search behavior from being lost through translation, as well as creating a unique and distinct distribution of questions per language.
paragraphs.zh: 这些问题由母语者或语言能力极高的使用者编写，其指导原则是：必须具备良好的语言流利度，才能找到和/或浏览答案所依据的来源。 未使用任何初始英语数据集。 这种设计避免了因翻译而丢失特定于某种语言的术语、文化背景以及搜索行为，同时为每种语言创造了独特且截然不同的问题分布。

sents.en: The questions were authored by native or highly proficient speakers, with the guiding principle that fluency of the language would be required to find and/or navigate the sources from which the answers draw upon.
sents.zh: 这些问题由母语者或语言能力极高的使用者编写，其指导原则是：必须具备良好的语言流利度，才能找到和/或浏览答案所依据的来源。

sents.en: No seed English dataset was used.
sents.zh: 未使用任何初始英语数据集。

sents.en: This design preserved language-specific terminology, cultural context, and search behavior from being lost through translation, as well as creating a unique and distinct distribution of questions per language.
sents.zh: 这种设计避免了因翻译而丢失特定于某种语言的术语、文化背景以及搜索行为，同时为每种语言创造了独特且截然不同的问题分布。

paragraphs.en: A central goal of HyperBrowseComp is to move beyond search over plain webpage text. Many questions require, or are substantially aided by, evidence from images, video frames, spoken audio, scanned documents, digitized books, tables, figures, maps, or other visually rendered sources. However, multimodal evidence is not a strict requirement for every question: we also retain sufficiently challenging text-based questions when they satisfy the benchmark’s broader goal of difficult, persistent web search.
paragraphs.zh: HyperBrowseComp 的一个核心目标是超越对普通网页文本的简单搜索。 许多问题需要来自图像、视频帧、语音音频、扫描文档、数字化书籍、表格、图表、地图或其他视觉化呈现来源的证据，或者这些证据能显著帮助解决问题。 然而，多模态证据并非每个问题的硬性要求：只要这些问题能够满足该基准测试中“困难且持久的网络搜索”这一更广泛的目标，我们也会保留足够具有挑战性的纯文本问题。

paragraphs.en: For questions involving non-textual evidence, the relevant modality is often not explicitly stated in the question. An agent may first need to discover that the decisive information appears in a recording, scanned document, image, navigating through map, or another medium before locating the answer.
paragraphs.zh: 对于涉及非文本证据的问题，相关模态通常并未在问题中明确说明。 智能体可能首先需要发现决定性信息出现在录音、扫描文档、图像、地图导航或其他媒介中，然后才能找到答案。

paragraphs.en: We retain BrowseComp’s useful combination of difficult retrieval and concise answer verification, while reducing opportunities for shortcut solutions based on popular entities or formulaic constraint matching. Questions preferentially target obscure, highly specific, but publicly accessible information. The decisive evidence may be poorly indexed, embedded within a long source, available only within a specific part of a video or document, or otherwise difficult to locate through a conventional keyword search. Many questions were further enhanced with additional hops of clue chains, requiring the models to parse multiple ambiguous overlapping information.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留了 BrowseComp 中难题检索与简洁答案验证的有效结合，同时减少了基于热门实体或公式化约束匹配的捷径解决方案的可能性。 问题优先针对冷门、高度具体但可公开获取的信息。 决定性证据可能索引不佳、嵌入在冗长的来源材料中、仅存在于视频或文档的特定部分，或者通过传统关键词搜索难以定位。 许多问题还通过添加额外的线索链环节进行了增强，要求模型解析多个存在歧义且相互重叠的信息。

paragraphs.en: All questions are manually authored by speakers of the corresponding languages. Our questions are written by native speakers, or close to native-level speakers who have lived in cities where these languages are spoken widely from either birth or from a young age. They use these languages daily and know the local culture and contexts of those regions. Before contributing data, annotators read a detailed guideline covering difficulty, uniqueness, source quality, temporal scope, multilinguality, and use of heterogeneous evidence sources. Appendix A provides more detail along with the full annotation guidelines. Annotators begin from a publicly verifiable answer and its supporting evidence, then construct a question that requires nontrivial search to recover that answer.

paragraphs.en: For every candidate item, the author submits the question, canonical answer, acceptable aliases, relevant URLs, exact evidence locations, source language, relevant modalities, access dates, and a concise solution trace. Exact evidence locations may include a quotation, page number, table or figure identifier, video timestamp, audio interval, or map location. The solution trace records a sufficient path to the answer, but is not assumed to be the only valid search trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个候选条目，作者需提交问题、标准答案、可接受的别名、相关 URL、确切的证据位置、源语言、相关模态、访问日期以及一个简洁的解题路径。 确切的证据位置可能包括引文、页码、表格或图表标识符、视频时间戳、音频时间区间或地图位置。 解题路径记录了通往答案的充分步骤，但并不意味着这是唯一有效的搜索轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We permit a broad range of publicly accessible internet sources, subject to several constraints. A source must not require payment, authentication, private group membership, or access to a personal account. We exclude questions that depend on isolated posts by individual social-media users because such content is fragile and may create privacy concerns. Social-media content may be used when it is published by an official institutional or organizational account, or when it documents a widely reported public event and can be corroborated by durable independent sources. We exclude sensitive personal information about private individuals even when it is technically accessible online, and only allow public figure-related questions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们允许使用广泛的可公开访问的互联网来源，但需遵守若干限制。 某个来源不得需要付费、身份验证、加入私人群组或访问个人账户。 我们不处理依赖个体社交媒体用户孤立性帖子的问题，因为这类内容不稳定且可能引发隐私问题。 当社交媒体内容由官方机构或组织账户发布时，或者当它记录了被广泛报道的公共事件并能通过可靠的独立来源证实时，可以加以使用。 即使某些关于私人个体的敏感个人信息在技术上可以在线获取，我们也不会允许使用；我们仅允许与公众人物相关的问题。

paragraphs.en: Each candidate question is assigned to a second annotator who validates the data. The validator checks that the question is interpretable, the answer is correct and unique, all necessary evidence is accessible and correct, and any time-sensitive wording is appropriately bounded. The validator also checks whether substantially different entities satisfy the stated constraints. When a question is insufficiently specific, the validator requests one or more non-leading disambiguating constraints, called ‘fingerprints’. These fingerprints were designed not to make the question easier to search; their purpose is to increase confidence that the recovered answer originates from the sources that match the said fingerprints. For example, if multiple books match a question’s clues, a fingerprint might specify that ”the book contains exactly 13 illustrations of cats”, a constraint that is unhelpful for search, but definitive for disambiguation. The validator was also able to request that the difficulty of the question be raised, often after regular group discussions on the partially created datapoints. This led to increasingly more difficult questions being created as the group collectively identified particular weaknesses in the current frontier models.
paragraphs.zh: 每个候选问题都会被分配给第二位标注员，由其验证数据。 验证员会检查问题是否具有可解释性，答案是否正确且唯一，所有必要证据是否可用且正确，以及任何有时间敏感性的措辞是否得到了适当的限定。 验证员还会检查是否存在差异显著但同样满足所述约束条件的实体。 当问题不够具体时，验证员会要求添加一个或多个非引导性的消歧约束，称为“指纹”。 这些“指纹”的设计并非为了让问题更容易被搜索到；其目的是提高对检索到的答案源自与这些“指纹”匹配的信息源的信心。 例如，如果有多本书符合某个问题的线索，“指纹”可能会规定“这本书恰好包含13幅猫的插图”，这一约束虽然对搜索没有帮助，但对消歧却具有决定性意义。 验证员还可以要求提高问题的难度，这通常是在对部分创建的数据点进行了常规小组讨论之后进行的。 随着团队集体识别出当前前沿模型存在的特定弱点，由此也催生了难度越来越高的问题。

paragraphs.en: To identify questions that could be answered without web search, we evaluated the submitted questions using seven models without internet access: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, Gemini 3.7 Flash, GLM-4.7, GPT-OSS-120B ( OpenAI et al., 2025 ) , Kimi K2 Thinking ( Team et al., 2026 ) , MiniMax-M2 ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and DeepSeek-V3.2 ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ) . As shown in Table 7 in Appendix C.1 , 121 questions were answered correctly by at least one model, including 54 answered correctly by at least two models.
paragraphs.zh: 为了识别无需网络搜索即可回答的问题，我们使用七款无法访问互联网的智能体模型对提交的问题进行了评估：Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview、Gemini 3.7 Flash、GLM-4.7、GPT-OSS-120B（OpenAI 等，2025）、Kimi K2 Thinking（Team 等，2026）、MiniMax-M2（Chen 等，2026）以及 DeepSeek-V3.2（DeepSeek-AI 等，2025）。 如附录 C.1 中的表 7 所示，有 121 个问题至少被一款智能体模型正确回答，其中 54 个问题至少被两款智能体模型正确回答。

paragraphs.en: We applied a combined exclusion rule: remove any question answered correctly by two or more models , or by at least one model if the question required a highly specific answer , such as a precise numerical value judged unlikely to be guessed correctly. For less specific answers, requiring two correct model responses helps avoid excluding a difficult question because of a single lucky guess, such as naming a city in Indonesia by chance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们应用了一种组合排除规则：移除任何被两个或更多模型正确回答的问题；或者，如果问题需要高度特定的答案（例如一个被认为不太可能被正确猜中的精确数值），则只要有一个模型正确回答就予以移除。 对于要求不那么具体的答案，需要两个模型都正确回答有助于避免因为单个幸运猜测而排除难题，例如偶然说出印度尼西亚的一个城市名称。

The details on the LLM specificity assessment are presented in Appendix C.1 .

paragraphs.en: To reduce accidental benchmark contamination, we release the dataset in encoded form and provide a decoding key for deliberate access. This adds a barrier against incidental ingestion by automated data collection pipelines while preserving access for those intentionally seeking the data. While this approach does not prevent bad-faith actors from intentionally training on the test set, mitigating intentional contamination is orthogonal to our work.
paragraphs.zh: 为了减少基准测试的意外污染，我们以编码形式发布数据集，并提供一个解码密钥以便有意访问。 这为自动化数据收集流程设置了一道障碍，防止其意外获取数据，同时保留了有意寻求该数据者的访问权限。 虽然这种方法无法阻止恶意行为者故意在测试集上进行训练，但减轻有意污染的问题与我们工作的目标无关。

paragraphs.en: HyperBrowseComp contains 423 questions written in 13 languages , with the language distribution shown in Figure 2(a) . Of these, approximately 64.3% were classified as requiring at least one non-text modality, based on both the question text and the corresponding Proof to Answer field. The classification was performed by an LLM and subsequently verified by human reviewers; further details are provided in C.1 . Figure 2(b) shows how frequently each modality appears across the questions. Video/YouTube is the most frequent source category (39.0%), followed by PDF/book/OCR (29.8%) and Image (18.4%). Arithmetic modality (28.1%) refers to questions requiring calculations from retrieved information. Categories can overlap, as a question may receive multiple tags. All percentages use the full dataset of 423 questions as the denominator.

paragraphs.en: The dataset spans 12 primary domains plus an Other category , as shown in Figure 2(c) . As in BrowseComp benchmark ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , the topic for each question was classified post hoc using a prompted LLM (see C.1 for more details). paragraphs.en: We evaluate the HyperBrowseComp benchmark on five models: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview , Gemini 3.7 Flash , GPT-5.6 Terra , GPT-5.6 Luna , GPT-5.6 Sol . Models are evaluated across three browsing settings: built-in search , Exa ( Exa, 2026 ) , and OWL ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , which has also been used in MM-BrowseComp ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Built-in search leverages each provider’s native search integration, evaluating the model and its proprietary search system jointly. Exa provides a common interface via standardized web_search and web_fetch tools. OWL, by contrast, operates as an isolated multi-agent framework equipped with browsing and multimodal capabilities and is evaluated as a distinct agent-system harness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五个模型上评估了 HyperBrowseComp 基准：Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview、Gemini 3.7 Flash、GPT-5.6 Terra、GPT-5.6 Luna 和 GPT-5.6 Sol。 这些模型在三种浏览设置下进行评估：内置搜索、Exa（Exa, 2026）以及 OWL（Hu et al., 2025），后者也用于 MM-BrowseComp（Li et al., 2025）。 内置搜索利用各提供商的原生搜索集成功能，对模型及其专有搜索系统联合进行评估。 Exa 通过标准化的 web_search 和 web_fetch 工具提供一个通用接口。 相比之下，OWL 作为一个独立的多人智能体框架运行，具备浏览和多模态能力，并以一个独立的智能体-系统组合进行评估。

paragraphs.zh: OWL 代币结合了工作流痕迹以及独立的评估/评分调用，总计覆盖所有 423 次最终尝试；其中 330 次完成的尝试获得了评分，而 93 次最终的工作流失败则计为错误。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval and harness sensitivity. Replacing built-in search with Exa reveals stark harness sensitivity across providers: while Exa improves GPT-5.6 Sol, it severely degrades accuracy across both Gemini variants. For the OWL -based harness, evaluation was hindered by tool-calling stability: out of all planned queries, 93 runs encountered terminal runtime failures. Following prior work, we count these unhandled execution errors as incorrect, resulting in a substantial drop between its conditional completion accuracy and its overall score. Even if we calculate correctness on completed attempts with the OWL -based harness, Gemini 3.7 Flash still yields 22.73% accuracy, noticeably lower than its built-in search counterpart. Collectively, these discrepancies demonstrate that web-agent efficacy cannot be assessed in isolation from the retrieval harness. The steep drop in Gemini’s performance under Exa indicates that proprietary models are tightly co-adapted to their native search ecosystems (e.g., Google Search or YouTube).
paragraphs.zh: 检索与工具链的敏感性。 将内置搜索替换为 Exa 后，不同提供商的工具链表现出显著的敏感性：尽管 Exa 提升了 GPT-5.6 Sol 的性能，却严重降低了两种 Gemini 变体的准确性。 对于基于 OWL 的工具链，工具调用稳定性问题阻碍了评估：在所有计划查询中，有 93 次运行遭遇了终端运行时故障。 遵循先前的研究，我们将这些未处理的执行错误视为错误结果，导致其条件完成准确率与整体得分之间出现大幅下降。 即使我们仅基于成功完成的尝试来计算基于 OWL 工具链的正确性，Gemini 3.7 Flash 的准确率仍为 22.73%，明显低于使用内置搜索的版本。 综合来看，这些差异表明网络智能体的有效性无法脱离检索工具链单独评估。 Gemini 在 Exa 环境下性能的大幅下降表明，专有模型与其原生搜索生态系统（例如 Google Search 或 YouTube）存在紧密的协同适配关系。

paragraphs.en: OWL workload and failures. paragraphs.en: These results show that beyond performance, the harness also affects cost. However, cost does not necessarily align with performance. Specifically, Gemini’s internal search harness achieves better performance despite being cheaper than the Exa or OWL harnesses. Hence, designing an efficient yet accurate browsing harness is a promising orthogonal direction for future work that can benefit from our benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，除了性能之外，该框架还会影响成本。 然而，成本并不一定与性能成正比。 具体来说，Gemini 的内部搜索框架尽管比 Exa 或 OWL 框架更便宜，却实现了更好的性能。 因此，设计一个既高效又准确的浏览框架，是一个有前景的独立研究方向，未来工作可以借助我们的基准测试从中受益。

paragraphs.en: To contextualize the model’s accuracy and cost, we evaluated human performance on 30 randomly sampled questions, with ten each in Indonesian, Thai, and Vietnamese. We recruited native speakers who were permitted to browse the web but prohibited from using LLM assistance when answering our questions. Participants were allowed to give up after one hour. They submitted answers for 26 questions and gave up on four. Across all 30 attempts, including give-ups, the mean recorded elapsed time was 89.5 minutes and the median was 54.6 minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 为了说明模型的准确率和成本，我们对 30 个随机抽取的问题评估了人类的表现，其中印尼语、泰语和越南语各十题。 我们招募了母语者，允许他们在回答问题时浏览网页，但禁止使用大型语言模型（LLM）的辅助。 参与者在一小时后可以选择放弃。 他们提交了 26 道题的答案，并放弃了四道题。 在所有 30 次尝试中（包括放弃的情况），记录的平均耗时为 89.5 分钟，中位数为 54.6 分钟。

paragraphs.en: Contrasting this run with our best-performing model, Gemini 3.7 Flash, on the same subset shows that their overall performance is comparable, though their correctness does not always overlap; both human annotators and Gemini answered correctly on only 8 questions. What proves difficult for the model does not appear to translate directly to humans. In this sample, which is consistent with the performance on the full set (Figure 7 in Appendix), Indonesian and Thai are among the most difficult for the model, whereas Vietnamese is the easiest. In contrast, humans solved Indonesian questions accurately and quickly, yet consistently struggled on Thai. Vietnamese questions, while accurate, took humans longer to solve. Another aspect that is difficult to analyze is individual human skill, as annotators might search differently from one another, yielding different behavior. While this is an interesting orthogonal research question, a deeper dive remains outside the scope of this work.
paragraphs.zh: 将此次运行与我们在相同子集上表现最佳模型 Gemini 3.7 Flash 的表现进行比较可以发现，两者的整体性能相当，但正确性并不总是完全一致；无论是人类标注者还是 Gemini，都仅在 8 个问题中给出了正确答案。 对模型而言具有挑战性的内容，似乎并不能直接对应到人类身上。 在这个样本中（其结果与完整数据集上的表现一致，参见附录中的图 7），印尼语和泰语是模型最难处理的语言之一，而越南语则最容易处理。 相比之下，人类能够准确且迅速地解决印尼语问题，但在泰语问题上却始终存在困难。 虽然人类在解决越南语问题时表现准确，但所需时间更长。 另一个难以分析的方面是个体人类的技能差异，因为不同标注者的搜索方式可能不同，从而导致不同的行为结果。 尽管这是一个有趣的独立研究问题，但更深入的分析超出了本研究的范围。

paragraphs.en: HyperBrowseComp is a benchmark of 423 manually authored questions, which provides a testbed for developing more capable and efficient browsing agents across 13 languages, 8 modalities, and 13 primary domains. The questions are grounded in the linguistic and cultural environments and require agents to locate and connect evidence across webpages, images, videos, audio, scanned documents, maps, and other sources. Independent validation and a multi-model no-internet audit help ensure that the benchmark measures difficult evidence discovery rather than recall from parametric knowledge. The results demonstrate that the current web-enabled agents leave substantial room for improvement. The strongest evaluated configuration achieves 31.68% accuracy, while about 57.68% of questions receive no correct answer from any of the five models evaluated with native search. These findings motivate further research on open web agents that can interpret implicit, language- and culture-specific clues and reliably discover, connect, and verify heterogeneous evidence.
paragraphs.zh: HyperBrowseComp 是一个包含 423 个人工编写问题的基准测试，为开发更强大、高效的浏览智能体提供了测试平台，涵盖 13 种语言、8 种模态和 13 个主要领域。 这些问题基于特定的语言和文化环境，要求智能体能够在网页、图像、视频、音频、扫描文档、地图和其他来源中查找并关联证据。 独立的验证以及多模型无网络审计有助于确保该基准测试衡量的是困难的证据发现能力，而非从参数化知识中的回忆能力。 结果表明，当前的网络支持型智能体仍存在较大的改进空间。 评估中最强的配置实现了 31.68% 的准确率，而约 57.68% 的问题在五个使用原生搜索进行评估的模型中均未得到正确答案。 这些发现推动了关于开放网络智能体的进一步研究，这类智能体需要能够解读隐性的、具有语言和文化特定性的线索，并可靠地发现、关联和验证异构证据。

paragraphs.en: A key limitation of this work is the scope of our model evaluation. paragraphs.en: Our evaluation focuses mainly on comparing models and covers only two retrieval settings: provider-native search and Exa, as well as an OWL-based harness, following prior work. Because these evaluations are costly, we test Exa with only a subset of models and leave a broader study of harness designs for future work. The reported scores therefore reflect the tested combinations of models and tools, and performance may change with a different harness. HyperBrowseComp can also help evaluate how well a harness supports a model in finding and using evidence across languages and formats. Future studies can keep the model fixed while comparing search tools, and strategies for using these tools under comparable resource budgets. This would extend the benchmark’s use to evaluating progress in harness integration alongside model capability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估主要侧重于模型比较，仅涵盖两种检索设置：提供商原生搜索和 Exa，以及一种基于 OWL 的辅助工具，这与先前的研究一致。 由于这些评估成本高昂，我们仅使用部分模型来测试 Exa，而将更广泛的辅助工具设计研究留待未来进行。 因此，所报告的分数反映了已测试的模型与工具组合，若使用不同的辅助工具，性能可能会发生变化。 HyperBrowseComp 还有助于评估辅助工具在跨语言、跨格式查找和使用证据方面的支持能力。 未来的研究可以在固定模型的前提下，比较不同的搜索工具，以及在资源预算相当的情况下使用这些工具的策略。 这将使该基准测试的应用范围扩展到评估辅助工具集成方面的进展，以及模型能力的提升。

paragraphs.en: This work aims to support reproducibility by documenting the experimental setup, data sources, evaluation procedures, and implementation details. Appendices A – C additionally provide the exact resolved prompts and tool schemas, final model and API identifiers, harness parameters, retry and error records, grading results, and cost. Because live webpages, search rankings, and provider tools may change, exact reruns can differ; the preserved outputs and traces can be used to support auditing of the reported results. Full HyperBrowseComp data, annotation guideline, and code will be public upon paper release.

paragraphs.en: Our questions are written by native speakers or near-native speakers who have lived since birth or a young age in cities where these languages are widely spoken. Before starting the annotation process, annotators attended a presentation outlining the guidelines, followed by a Q&A session to ensure a thorough understanding of the task. We then shared the presentation slides with them for ongoing reference. Given the deck’s length and visual presentation format, it cannot fit into the paper’s appendix. paragraphs.en: For the annotator selection to evaluate our benchmark, we chose the undergrad student with the top of the class from the school of computer science (for Thai) and the school of business (for Indonesian and Vietnamese). For the guidelines, we used a platform to count the time for each question, where we asked them to do only 1 hrs for each question; if the time exceeds the limit, annotators can give up. In addition, we allow annotators to search for the answer on the internet, but do not allow them to use any AI assistant.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们基准测试的标注者选择过程，我们从计算机科学系（针对泰语）和商学院（针对印尼语和越南语）中挑选了成绩排名最高的本科生。 这些标注者曾通过多项问答和自然语言推理数据集的考试（Artetxe 等人，2020；Lewis 等人，2020；Chomphooyod 等人，2026），且得分均超过90%。 关于指导方针，我们使用了一个平台来记录每道题目的作答时间，要求他们每道题最多只能花费1小时；如果超出时间限制，标注者可以放弃该题。 此外，我们允许标注者在互联网上搜索答案，但不允许他们使用任何人工智能助手。

paragraphs.en: OWL operates as an isolated multi-agent workforce framework built on CAMEL, where a primary model assumes the roles of task manager, coordinator, web/multimodal researcher, and synthesizer. The web specialist queries DuckDuckGo and Wikipedia before passing URLs to a headless Chromium browser using visual-web agents with annotated screenshots. A multimodal specialist directly inspects images, decodes video frames, renders PDF pages, and processes audio files.

paragraphs.en: Token usage: for ReAct, the sum of input and output tokens from answering, tool-using, finalization, and grading calls; for OWL, the sum across all workforce roles and perception calls, reported separately from the Inspect grading call;

paragraphs.zh: 执行时间：每个样本的端到端耗时，包括答案生成和评分；以及

paragraphs.en: Sample-level errors: the number and type of execution or grading failures, including failures that remain after retrying.

paragraphs.en: We compare the English question translations for the 244 shared failures and the 179 questions with at least one recorded correct answer. The former group includes two questions with unresolved model outcomes. We lowercase and tokenize the translations, remove stopwords and tokens shorter than three characters, and retain terms occurring in at least eight and at most 80% of the 423 questions. TF-IDF weights use raw term counts and smoothed inverse document frequency, followed by per-question L 2 L_{2} normalization. We rank the 264 eligible terms by mean TF-IDF in the zero-success group minus mean TF-IDF in the solved group. Figure 10 displays the 100 highest positive differences. Its dots show the proportion of questions containing each term that have no recorded correct answer, rather than TF-IDF scores; the reference rate is 244/423 (57.68%). The top-ranked terms are “issue” (19/25; 76.0%), “video” (35/47; 74.5%), and “page” (30/39; 76.9%). These exploratory associations do not establish that particular words cause difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了 244 个共享故障的英文问题翻译，以及至少有一个记录的正确答案的 179 个问题。 前者包括两个模型结果尚未解决的问题。 我们将这些翻译转为小写并进行分词，移除停用词和长度少于三个字符的词元，并保留在 423 个问题中至少出现八次且最多出现 80% 的术语。 TF-IDF 权重使用原始词项计数和平滑后的逆文档频率，随后对每个问题进行 L₂ L_{2} 归一化。 我们根据零成功组中的平均 TF-IDF 减去已解决组中的平均 TF-IDF，对 264 个符合条件的术语进行排序。 图 10 显示了 100 个最高的正值差异。 图中的点表示包含每个术语且没有记录正确答案的问题所占比例，而非 TF-IDF 分数；参考率为 244/423（57.68%）。 排名最高的术语是“issue”（19/25；76.0%）、“video”（35/47；74.5%）和“page”（30/39；76.9%）。 这些探索性关联并不能证明特定词语会导致困难。
